behaviors: ChrW(&H57) plus SCRIPT.SHell constructs WScript.Shell. Chr/ChrW concatenation constructs %comspec% and /c. WSH Run requests window style zero.
PowerShell uses -EX bypass, -NOp, -W 1 and -c; DeviceCredentialDeployment.exe is invoked before the downloader. Its name alone establishes no privilege escalation.
Nested IEX evaluates UTF8.GetString(Convert.FromBase64String(...)); the decoded program uses Add-Type and URLMon URLDownloadToFile.
Downloads a .vbe to $env:TEMP from http://198.12.126.164/xampp/eva/, sleeps three seconds and invokes the same .vbe through Invoke-Expression.
HTA closes its window; excessive tabs, mixed case and random identifiers conceal the launcher.
samples.remote_analysis: Read-only HTTP payload fetch timed out. No VBE payload bytes or malware-family identification available.

samples.identity: HTML smuggler carrying a ZIP-disguised-as-RAR HTA downloader
behaviors: The unknown extension contains XHTML, not a native executable.
A zero-size broken image onerror reads two hidden DOM elements and reconstructs eval from e+va+l.
The second DOM script reconstructs eval, atob and replaceAll; removes asterisk padding from the first DOM payload and decodes/evaluates it.
Recovered JavaScript installs a one-shot document.onmousemove callback. A Windows-platform gate throws on other platforms before download.
The callback creates an anchor containing a Base64 ZIP and triggers its download using a RAR MIME type and .rar filename.

ZIP CRC checks succeeded. The archive contains a minimized HTA with no taskbar entry. Its VBScript reconstructs %WINDIR%\system32\mshta.exe and a trycloudflare.com HTTPS URL ending in .jpeg, then launches it through WScript.Shell.Run.

The outer decoded script later references columnsITV outside its callback-local scope. This raises ReferenceError and prevents the appended tracking image from being reached; the mouse callback was already registered.
samples.remote_analysis: Reconstructed Cloudflare tunnel URL failed DNS resolution. Unused speedyy7O.com string in the HTA has no demonstrated network call.
